## Google ADK Enterprise Observability — Distributed Traces, Spans & Correlated Logs (Dynatrace Grail)
Monitors **OpenTelemetry Distributed Trace Waterfalls** (`invoke_agent` -> `call_llm` -> `execute_tool`), **Span Latency by Operation**, and **Correlated GenAI Events / Logs** ingested via `/api/v2/otlp/v1/traces` and `/api/v2/otlp/v1/logs`.

1.title: 1. Distributed Trace Spans by Operation (invoke_agent, call_llm, execute_tool)
1.query: fetch spans | filter service.name == "adk-ops-agent" or isNotNull(gen_ai.agent.name) or isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) | summarize span_count = count(), avg_duration_ms = avg(duration) / 1000000, by: { span.name }

2.title: 2. Recent ADK Distributed Trace Spans Waterfall Table
2.query: fetch spans | filter service.name == "adk-ops-agent" or isNotNull(gen_ai.agent.name) or isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) | sort start_time desc | fields start_time, span.name, duration, `gen_ai.agent.name`, `gen_ai.tool.name`, `gen_ai.request.model`, trace.id, span.id | limit 50

3.title: 3. Tool Execution Span Count & Duration Breakdown
3.query: timeseries { count = count(gen_ai.execute_tool.duration), avg_sec = avg(gen_ai.execute_tool.duration) }, by: { `gen_ai.tool.name` }

4.title: 4. Correlated ADK Agent Logs & GenAI Inference Events
4.query: fetch logs | filter service.name == "adk-ops-agent" or contains(content, "gen_ai") | sort timestamp desc | fields timestamp, status, content, trace_id, span_id | limit 50
